## Summary

Six smaller-but-real defects in `src/bos/worker.ts` and `src/bos/slash-commands/`. Context: the panel never sends `usePubSub` (payload at agent.ts:745-755), so the non-pubsub paths below are the ones that actually run.

### 1. User skills silently overwrite built-in slash commands (worker.ts:206 + registry.ts:69-73)

`loadSkillsFromHomeDir()` runs after built-ins are registered, and `register()` warns "duplicate command registration" but **still overwrites** (`commands.set(key, cmd)`). A `~/.agents/skills/goal/SKILL.md` replaces `/goal` — alias `g` now resolves to the skill echo and goal functionality is silently destroyed. Same for `undo`, `init`, `ping`, `search`...

**Fix:** in `register()`, skip when `commands.has(key)` (built-ins win); in `loadSkillsFromDir`, skip names colliding with existing commands/aliases.

### 2. Slash-path inline deps init drops `apiKey`/`toolPermissions`/`sandboxEnabled` (worker.ts:454-462)

The chat path passes `apiKey`, `toolPermissions`, `sandboxEnabled` and recreates deps on apiKey drift; the inline slash path does only `composeRoot({ workspaceRoot: wsRoot })`. Consequence: fresh worker whose `init` failed → first slash builds `deps.aiAgent` without the key → AI-augmented tools degrade/fail auth; after a settings key change, slash keeps stale deps forever.

**Fix:** mirror the chat path's brainOptions and apiKey-drift check.

### 3. `auto.ts:286` — abort signal never reaches `generateScopeAndEval`; cancel during `/auto` pre-analysis is ineffective

No `signal` argument; `streamCollect` has no abort wiring; the only check is once before the path begins. On cancel the LLM stream runs to completion, then the scope/eval files are written post-abort — tokens consumed and files written that the user explicitly cancelled.

**Fix:** pass `signal` through, check after `streamCollect` and before the writes.

### 4. `contradiction.ts:172-184` — AI-stream promise has no abort listener; cancel with a stalled stream never resolves

`signal.aborted` is only observed inside the token callback; the probe agent has no `timeoutSecs` (contrast ping.ts:97), and `handleCancel` only stops `currentAgent` — never the triz-contradiction probe. If cancel fires while the stream produces no further tokens, the promise never settles → neither `done` nor `error` → panel hang.

**Fix:** add a `once` abort listener that closes the probe and resolves; add a `timeoutSecs`.

### 5. `undo.ts:56-60` — module-global `hasSnapshot` makes `/undo` report "Nothing to undo" after worker restart

A VS Code reload respawns the worker, resetting `hasSnapshot`, while `jj log -r @` still shows the `AI:` description. The command already derives the correct value at :87.

**Fix:** derive `hasSnapshot` from the @ description at execute() start instead of module state.

### 6. `s-curve.ts:11` — TRL override not range-validated

`parseInt(trlMatch[1], 10) as TRLLevel` accepts 99 and passes through; `trl_assessor.ts:208` uses `input.userProvidedTRL || 3` without clamping, so TRL 99 can reach artifacts. Same class as the already-filed /ariz param bug (#1), different command.

**Fix:** validate 1-9 before casting.
title: Worker/slash robustness: user skill dirs silently overwrite built-in commands; slash-path deps init drops apiKey; auto.ts abort never reaches pre-analysis; contradiction.ts can hang on cancel; undo.ts state lost on restart; s-curve TRL unvalidated
